mentions.heading: Industry consolidation and customer vertical integration
mentions.detail: Semiconductor competitor consolidation and customer vertical integration could erode market share and force restructuring
mentions.quote: Consolidation among competitors and integration among customers could erode our market share, impair our capacity to compete and require us to restructure our operations, any of which could have a material adverse effect on our business.

mentions.heading: Competitors may receive governmental subsidies or incentives
mentions.detail: US and EU semiconductor funding legislation; risk of not accessing, reduction or clawback of awards, or competitors receiving more
mentions.quote: For example, the United States and the European Union have enacted legislation to provide funding and incentives for semiconductor research, development, and manufacturing in their respective regions.
